name: manga-reader-monorepo
description: Manga Reader Web Application (QL-DocTruyen) — Production-oriented modular monolith foundation

scripts.test: pnpm test:contracts && pnpm test:web && pnpm test:api
scripts.lint:api: uv --directory apps/api run ruff check src tests ../../database ../../tests
scripts.format:check:api: uv --directory apps/api run ruff format --check src tests ../../database ../../tests
scripts.format:write: pnpm --filter @manga-reader/contracts format:write && pnpm --filter @manga-reader/web format:write && uv --directory apps/api run ruff format src tests ../../database ../../tests
scripts.db:migrate: uv --project apps/api run alembic -c database/alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.db:migrate:sql: uv --project apps/api run alembic -c database/alembic.ini upgrade head --sql
scripts.db:current: uv --project apps/api run alembic -c database/alembic.ini current
scripts.check:all: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
